decisions.reason: The low-noise burner is a component improvement of the firm's core infrared heating technology, so the firm can interpret results and refine it with its engineering know-how.
The gas infrared plaque heater sits squarely in the firm's established product line and was presented on its own page, indicating it is a core offering the firm can assimilate and improve.
The luminous radiant heater builds directly on existing infrared know-how in an industry with strong in-house R&D, so the firm is well placed to learn from early results and keep it.
The gas-fired tube heater is closely related to the firm's core competence, though overlap with Product F could lead to some portfolio consolidation in a narrow range.
The standard plaque heater is a staple of the firm's established offer with its own web page, making it a well-understood product the firm will keep.
This tube heater builds on familiar technology, but its similarity to Product D raises a modest chance of being merged or replaced.
